message.text: Confirmed there's just one interface with one implementation here, so I'll write up the answer now.

h13.

**`*markdown.service` (the only implementation) — built by `markdown.NewService(...)` in `NewAPIV1Service`, then shared — held by `APIV1Service`, `RSSService`, and `memopayload.Runner`.**

**The interface**

`markdown.Service` is declared in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (line 31) with eight methods: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, and `RenameTag`.

**The implementation**

There is exactly one concrete type: the unexported `service` struct in the same file, which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance. I searched the whole Go tree for any other type implementing these methods (including test fakes or mocks) and found none, so every call at runtime and in tests goes through `*service`.

```57:60:internal/markdown/markdown.go
// service implements the Service interface.
type service struct {
	md goldmark.Markdown
}
```

The only variation is configuration rather than type. `NewService` accepts `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` options that add the custom `#tag` and `@mention` goldmark extenders on top of GFM, so different call sites get differently-configured instances of the same struct.

**Construction**

In production there is a single construction site, `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (lines 47–62), which enables both the tag and mention extensions. That one instance is then shared: `server/server.go` line 85 passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService`, so the RSS feed renderer and the API service use the same object.

Test code constructs its own instances with varying options: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go` (line 44, tags plus mentions), `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go` (line 427, tags only), and `server/router/rss/rss_test.go` (line 54, no extensions at all).

**Holders**

Three structs declare a field of the interface type:

- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` line 35 — used for `ExtractAll` in `memo_mention_helpers.go` line 32 and `GenerateSnippet` in `memo_service_webhooks.go` line 85.
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` in `server/router/rss/rss.go` line 45 — the only caller of `RenderHTML`, at line 339, for server-side feed rendering.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` line 16.

One caveat on that third holder: `memopayload.NewRunner` has no callers anywhere in the repo, so the `Runner` struct (and its `RunOnce` batch rebuild) is currently dead code. The live path into that package is the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, which takes `markdown.Service` as a parameter rather than holding it, and is called from `memo_service.go` at lines 108 and 447.
